0|f6ca96aa51a4ae1b3a416fbe85acdf1197c405a6|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"wifi: cfg80211: add support for link id attribute in NL80211_CMD_DEL_STATION
Currently whenever NL80211_CMD_DEL_STATION command is called without any
MAC address
column2: all stations present on that interface are flushed.

column1: However with MLO there is a need to flush such stations only which are
using at least a particular link from the AP MLD interface.
For example - 2 GHz and 5 GHz are part of an AP MLD.
To this interface
1. One non-EHT STA on 2 GHz link.
2. One non-EHT STA on 5 GHz link.
3. One Multi-Link STA having 2 GHz and 5 GHz as active links.
Now if currently
column2: NL80211_CMD_DEL_STATION is issued by the 2 GHz link

column1: without any MAC address
column2: it would flush all station entries. However

column1: flushing of station entry #2 at least is not desireable since it
is connected to 5 GHz link alone.
Hence
column2: add an option to pass link ID as well in the command so that if link

column1: ID is passed
column2: stations using that passed link ID alone would be flushed

column1: and others will not.
So after this
column2: station entries #1 and #3 alone would be flushed and #2 will

column1: remain as it is.
